messages:
tamika: opened PR to add a small migration note + examples for the new quota headers. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4987

oliver: can we keep snippets minimal? curl + python-sdk + node. and a one-liner promql so infra teams can verify dashboards.

sree: Added examples in the PR. curl: `curl -H 'x-redwood-quota: premium' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`

sree: python: `from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
client.request('/v1/generate', headers={'x-redwood-quota':'premium'})`

maria: quick note: include tip about header lowercasing (some proxies downcase). I added a small callout: "use lowercase header names to avoid proxy normalization issues".

tamika: also add promql: `sum by(tier_label) (increase(billing.tier_assigned[7d]))` and a line explaining it returns assignment counts per tier over 7d.

oliver: pinging eng about Dedicated nuance (reserve vs burst) so we can add a parenthetical. @maria can you add a tiny deprecation banner for legacy headers?

maria: added yellow banner and checklist: 1) pin SDK >=0.9.2, 2) update headers, 3) smoke test against staging.

docs-bot: Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-4987--docs.redwood.ai/migration/headers (expires in 7 days).

tamika: LGTM on staging. merging in 5m if no objections.

oliver: one more tiny suggestion: show old -> new diff inline e.g. `X-Redwood-Tier` -> `x-redwood-quota`. added that in PR comment.

maria: added diff. merging now, will follow up with a small PR to attach dashboard thumbnail later.
